messages:
alex chen: Heads up we're cutting over runtime 3.1.0 + api 4.12 in the 02:00 UTC change window. Need router and console steps.

marta ivanov: Confirming. Console has a minor UI toggle, router needs new route for /v2/stream. Runtime has KV eviction change — ensure pin fallback.

ryan perez: Router team: we can add the route but want to do a staged rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m. Any objections?

sophia lee: No objections. We'll set canary on api service too. Suggest pin old-model-quant to avoid perf regressions in first 2h.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled deployment: runtime@3.1.0, api@4.12. Start: 2024-11-03T02:00:00Z. Rollout policy: sequenced. Use --pin=old-model-quant for first pass.

jamal nguyen: Ops note: please add a rollback play in release notes. If latency > 150ms p50 for 10m, rollback runtime to 3.0.9 and unpin API.

olivia park: Adding to runbook: steps, quick rollback commands. I'll attach after this thread.

kevin wu: Console will be out for ~2min during feature flag flip. We'll schedule flag flip at 02:05 UTC after router 10% success.

marta ivanov: Also reminder: metric to watch - api.generated_tokens_per_second and runtime.kv_hit_rate. Will set alerts.

ryan perez: Router: starting canary step requires model routing rule update. Command: `kubectl apply -f router-canary-10p.yaml`

alex chen: Log snippet to monitor: `curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/health` should return 200 and x-runtime-version header.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: runtime rollout started on host pool gpux-1..gpux-8. Monitoring: healthchecks=green. Progress: 2/8 nodes updated.

sophia lee: Noted one slow host during canary, p95 token gen = 900ms on gpux-3, investigating logs now.

jamal nguyen: If gpux-3 is noisy, we should exclude it from rollout and continue. Marking as drainer: `orchestrator drain gpux-3`

olivia park: Updated runbook in docs console: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/release-3.1.0-4.12

kevin wu: :thumbsup: Confirming console flag flip queued.

ryan perez: Router canary 10% looks clean at 20m. Traffic error rate <= 0.1%. Proceeding to 50%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: api rollout 4.12 started, canary 10% -> 50% scheduled. Note: pinned model policy active for 2h after api deploy.

alex chen: Decision: keep pin for 2 hours, then evaluate quality metrics (generation perplexity, customer samples). If degradation, rollback both api and runtime.

marta ivanov: After 2h evaluation, ops will run `redwood rollback --services api,runtime --target 3.0.9,4.11` if needed. I'll own the call.

sophia lee: Post-mortem owner: ryan. Please collect perf profiles and KV cache stats.

ryan perez: Will collect profiles. Attaching quick command: `collect-profiles --since 02:00 --nodes gpux-* --out /tmp/profiles.tar.gz`

jamal nguyen: If rollback occurs, adjust console flags back and notify customer SSO owners. I'll send page.

alex chen: Thanks everyone. I'll close this thread after we confirm 100% rollout. Triage channel eng-oncall for rollbacks.
